closeupConfig._doc: Close-up camera is computed per side from the shoulder joint and the axilla region of shoulder-axilla-r1: target = centroid of that side's region vertices in the current skinned pose (the axilla). 'stageB' = production camera direction (like the stage-B tiles; falls back to 'axilla' when that direction would look at the axilla from behind). 'axilla' = torso frame direction forward*f + lateral*l + up*u + (joint->region centroid)*jointToRegion. Perspective camera at distanceM, fov chosen so the frame is +-halfHeightM around the target; near plane clips geometry more than clipFrontM in front of the target (like the stage-B crop sphere), so the other arm/head never block the view.
